view.label: Proveedor
view.sqlSentence: SELECT registry.id, document, name, alias, SUM(TRUNCATE(invoice_detail.quantity, 3)), SUM(TRUNCATE(invoice_detail.taxable_base * ((invoice_tax.percentage + invoice.surcharge + 100) / 100), 2)) FROM registry, invoice, invoice_detail, invoice_tax WHERE invoice.registry = registry.id AND invoice_detail.invoice = invoice.id AND invoice_tax.invoice_detail = invoice_detail.id AND invoice.type = ? AND invoice.issue_date BETWEEN ? AND ? GROUP BY 1,2,3,4 ORDER BY 6 DESC
